In [[knot theory]], [[prime knot]]s are those knots that are [[Indecomposable module|indecomposable]] under the operation of [[knot sum]].  The prime knots with ten or fewer crossings are listed here for quick comparison of their properties and varied naming schemes.

==Table of prime knots==
